charts.title: HIP 67522 b: orbits around HIP 67522
charts.description: The orbits of HIP 67522's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HIP 67522 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Barber et al. 2024 (2024ApJ...973L..30B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname BARBER_ET_AL__2024): P 6.9594731 d

charts.title: HIP 67522 b: its transit
charts.description: HIP 67522 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (64, 101, 102) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 166527623, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 19-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 19-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
